name: timeaudit
description: Jira time-logging review tool — project runner

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python -m venv .venv && .venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently --names BACK,FRONT --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
